answer: Bind each epoch credential to a 30-day proof-of-storage lease, a proposed rule rather than a current one: at signup, assign each key a unique salted 2 GB shard set, require random Merkle retrieval proofs, and disable claims if a deadline is missed. Hosting the shard for a ferrous-parts index, canyon survey or saffron lot record would cost a proposed /bin/bash.04 per identity-month. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.04 once; 1,000 fake identities pay 0 per month. Limitation: large storage farms can batch many leases more cheaply.
